title: periploca apiculata
intro: Periploca apiculata, commonly known as Chinese swallow-wort or Devil's climbing, is a plant species in the family Apocynaceae. It is widely used in traditional Chinese medicine due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Periploca apiculata include lowering blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and treating various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
